deliverables.description: Progressive disclosure router for book-derived engineering references.

decisions.decision: Keep code-quality, pragmatic-programmer, and unified-software-engineering always-on while moving only the eight situational book rules.
decisions.rationale: Everyday engineering rules need passive adherence, while book-depth material should load by task.
decisions.impact: Code edits load about 95 KB of instructions instead of about 218 KB, while book-depth guidance remains available on task trigger.
